comment: The audit VLAN may reach everything
The administration tier manages every Zone
Telnet is forbidden, even for administration
Front ends: DNS, Kerberos, LDAP, application back end
No database access from the DMZ
The DMZ never reaches the administration tier
The DMZ never reaches the workstations
Workstations: Active Directory, file shares, intranet
No direct database access from the workstations
Workstations never reach the administration tier
